Anika: Sales asks for Nimbus-XL onboard on Hosted with pin + SLA, target GA in ~6w. Feasible?
Ravi: Tight but possible. Need microbench (p50/p95/p99), mem, token cost.
Maya: They require p99 <200ms for short prompts. KV-cache and quant profile will matter.
Jo: Hosted-first, Dedicated later if they take pinned capacity + region isolation.
Sam: I'll run 5k prompt slice, quant 0.25/0.5/1.0. Microbench in 4d, full in 10d.
Ravi: Need streaming & function-calls compatibility tests; some quant modes drop tokens.
Anika: Customer wants 6mo deprecation notice + migration runbook. Can we offer that contractually?
Ravi: Yes with a compatibility shim + fallback to prior major during migrations. ~2 sprints to implement rollout+fallback.
Maya: Devex: expose `pin_version=true` API param and Console checkbox. Small spec needed.
Jo: Resource ask: 1 runtime eng for 3 sprints. PMs must prioritize.
Anika: Launch gates: 1) p99 <=220ms on Hosted with recommended quant; 2) no regressions in streaming/function-calls; 3) rollout+pin live; 4) Legal/Sec signoff.
Ravi: Canary policy: <=1% traffic, realtime fallback to pinned model on SLO breach. Ops to provision autoscale curve.
Sam: I'll publish bench artifacts to model card (perf matrix, recommended quant, migration notes).
Jo: Timeline: Day0 bench; D4 microbench; D10 full; D12 API/Console spec; D18 feature land; D25 canary; D42 GA.
Anika: Actions: Sam->bench(4d); Ravi->eng estimate & PRD(EOW); Maya->mockups(3d); Anika->customer+legal(2d).
deploy-bot: Bench thread created: https://redwood.internal/bench/1701123581
Anika: Reconvene Fri with bench results. :thumbsup:
